JOYSTAR Karida 700C Electric Bike for Adults
⚡ BUY AN E-BIKE & ENJOY SPECIAL HELMET PRICING! *Important: You must add the helmet to your cart for the discount to apply automatically.

Experience the perfect city commute with the Hiland Karida 700C Electric Bike. Combining a lightweight step-through frame with 7-speed versatility, this e-bike is designed to make your daily urban travels faster, easier, and much more enjoyable.

The ultimate city companion: Hiland Karida featuring a sleek step-through aluminum frame.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted for the modern commuter, the Karida balances a stable 250W front-hub motor with premium safety components for a smooth city ride."
Stable Power & Control
The Karida is powered by a 250W stable front-hub motor, which provides balanced weight distribution and better traction on urban roads. The 36V 7.8Ah removable battery is conveniently mounted on the rear rack, offering a reliable range of up to 40 miles while being UL2849 certified for maximum electrical safety.

Efficient power delivery with a high-capacity, safety-certified battery system.

Urban Safety Features

Stable Traction: Front-hub motor design improves handling on slippery or uneven city streets.

Shimano 7-Speed: Professional drivetrain for seamless gear changes across varying city terrain.

Mechanical Disc Brakes: Dual disc brakes provide powerful, responsive stopping in all weather conditions.

Full Commuter Kit: Comes standard with front and rear lights, full fenders, and a rear cargo rack.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding without the hassle. The Hiland Karida arrives 85% pre-assembled. All necessary tools and a detailed manual are included to help you finish the setup in minutes.

<

Watch: Quick assembly guide to get your Karida on the road fast.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

<

Watch the Hiland Karida in action: Smooth, fast, and effortless.

Our Guarantee
Your purchase is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame and a 1-year warranty on electrical components.
